messages:
Maria Chen: Dropping the Nocturne dark-theme Figma link. Focus for this thread: editor token contrast, small-multiples chart swatches, table row separators, and theme naming + accessibility badge. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/nocturne-theme
Diego Ramos: Loving the mood. Immediate flag: inline code and LINK color are almost the same hue — hard to scan in logs.
Isha Verma: Yep. Also chart dots in small-multiples collapse visually. Need palette with consistent perceived brightness across dark bg.
Tom Baker: Proposed token mapping for editor: keyword #4DB8FF, types #9EEBFF, string #A8E4A1, number #FFB07C, function #FFDDA3, comment #6E757B (de-saturated). Separates warm/cool.
Maria Chen: Good. Let's avoid very bright cyan for both link and keyword. Maybe move links to a warmer accent (amber) to differentiate.
DesignBot: Contrast scan (Nocturne v0.1): body 13px = 4.15:1, header 15px bold = 4.9:1, inline code = 3.5:1. Suggestions: increase inline-code weight or darken code bg by 6%.
Isha Verma: Mock CSS for editor/code block: 
```
/* Nocturne editor */
.token.keyword { color: #4DB8FF; }
.token.string { color: #A8E4A1; }
a, .token.link { color: #FFC86B; }
pre, code { background: rgba(12,14,16,0.68); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.025); padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; }
```
Diego Ramos: Charts: My 7-color proposal (colorblind-safe + grayscale-distinct): #FF6F61, #4EC6C6, #5A67FF, #FFD36A, #BFA0FF, #2FA05A, #FF9EB5. Legends at 12px semibold and swatches 10px square.
Tom Baker: Can we run a grayscale separability test? I worry amber vs coral on greyscale. Also reduce legend swatch size on narrow screens.
DesignBot: Grayscale test result: coral (#FF6F61) vs amber (#FFD36A) low contrast on greyscale. Recommend swapping amber to #FFC86B (higher luminance) or replace coral with #E85A4C.
Maria Chen: Decision: swap link color to #FFC86B, keep keywords #4DB8FF, and change amber to #FFC86B in charts. Update Figma after conversation.
Isha Verma: Accessibility badge idea: show small chip near theme toggle with text 'WCAG AA' or 'Needs Fix' and tooltip with details. Positive state green, warning amber.
Diego Ramos: Copy tweak: change menu label from "Dark" to "Nocturne (Dark)" and include small metadata line: "Optimized for console and editor". Improves discoverability.
Tom Baker: Focus states: use 2px solid #89C9FF at 60% opacity, no glow to reduce motion and keep keyboard focus visible.
QA-Bot: Quick scan queued. Will run colorblind simulation and regression tests on snapshots once Figma updated.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll push updates to Figma this afternoon and ping @DesignBot + @QA-Bot to re-run checks. :thumbsup:
